claims: "One Battle After Another" won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.
"One Battle After Another" is directed by Paul Thomas Anderson.
"One Battle After Another" is a Warner Bros. comedy-drama.
"One Battle After Another" is about an ex-revolutionary searching for his daughter.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony was held on March 15, 2026.
"One Battle After Another" won 6 Oscars total at the 98th Academy Awards.
"One Battle After Another" won Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sean Penn won Supporting Actor for "One Battle After Another" at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sara Murphy and Paul Thomas Anderson accepted as producers for "One Battle After Another".
"One Battle After Another" competed against Sinners, Bugonia, F1, Frankenstein, Hamnet, Marty Supreme, The Secret Agent, Sentimental Value, and Train Dreams at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners won 4 awards at the 98th Academy Awards.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners had a record-breaking 16 nominations at the 98th Academy Awards.
Ryan Coogler won best original screenplay for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards
